arguments.prompt:
Create a professional native pixel-art game animation SOURCE ATLAS of Aloy. EXACT selected incarnation: Horizon Zero Dawn (2017), Nora Seeker adult Aloy.

FIXED SOURCE APPEARANCE: Adult19+ Aloy, long braided red hair, Nora Seeker tribal armour, Hunter Bow and arrows; no Forbidden West glider or Sunwing. FIXED WEAPON: Hunter Bow. FIXED ACTION: Flèche du Hunter Bow d’Aloy. Effect: damage; delivery: projectile.

Adult fictional character. Nonsexual practical game sprites. Clean detailed 16-bit pixel art, readable coherent three-quarter side view facing screen-RIGHT. Preserve the selected incarnation, never mix later gear or abilities. Same anatomical proportions and pixel scale in all poses; standing body stature calibrates to 190 game pixels (short dwarf 150, ordinary human 190, tall 205, massive Space Marine 220). Kneeling stays naturally shorter. Complete equipment and silhouette in each cell with generous empty transparent margins on every side. All swords, staff tips, bow tips, spear/hammer ends and feet completely visible.

STRICT LAYOUT: EXACTLY FORTY-EIGHT separate complete figures: EIGHT equal COLUMNS by SIX equal ROWS, regular 8 x 6 grid. Transparent background. No labels, letters, numbers, grid, panels, ground, scenery, cast shadow or other people. Each group of FOUR is one real FOUR-FRAME sequence: independently drawn different postures with visibly different feet/limbs/weapon angles. Never duplicate figures or invent additional phases. Keep identical scale across every cell. Leave generous clear alpha gutters, never overlap or clip.

ROW 1: columns 1-4 INTRO: four distinct quiet positions, approach with one small step, bring hands/equipment up, plant feet, settle in readiness with equipment held safely without attacking. Columns 5-8 OUTRO: lower hands/equipment, turn shoulders, step back, settle. No firing.

ROW 2: columns 1-4 ROUND VICTORY: restrained nod and brief acknowledgment gesture, lift head, shift weight, settle with equipment held safely without attacking. Columns 5-8 ROUND DEFEAT: lower shoulders, catch breath, slightly stoop, steady and recover. No attacks.

ROW 3: columns 1-4 FINISHING PRESENTATION: Nock physical arrow, draw Hunter Bow, release forward, recover; no unrelated laser; four distinct stages: physical arrow at lowered bow, raise and nock, full draw facing right with arrow nock visibly at string and arrow aligned along the bow, release and recover. Only one physical arrow, no energy or detached magical effect. Non-graphic solo demonstration, no opponent. Columns 5-8 MATCH VICTORY: four distinctive calm personal acknowledgment positions, different body and hand positions from round victory, settle. No attack.

ROW 4: columns 1-4 MATCH DEFEAT: slowly lower posture, crouch or lean with lowered head, steady balance, settle; intact unharmed character. Columns 5-8 SUPER: a separate newly drawn four-stage sequence of Nock physical arrow, draw Hunter Bow, release forward, recover; no unrelated laser; four distinct stages: physical arrow at lowered bow, raise and nock, full draw facing right with arrow nock visibly at string and arrow aligned along the bow, release and recover. Only one physical arrow, no energy or detached magical effect. Different actual drawings from finishing presentation, same source action and effect.

ROW 5: columns 1-4 IDLE: four subtle breathing and actual weight-transfer positions, visibly different shoulders/hands/feet, equipment held safely without attacking. Columns 5-8 RUN: four real locomotion stride poses, alternating planted leg and moving leg, with equipment held safely, same stature and source costume.

ROW 6: columns 1-4 ORDINARY ACTION: Nock physical arrow, draw Hunter Bow, release forward, recover; no unrelated laser; four distinct stages: physical arrow at lowered bow, raise and nock, full draw facing right with arrow nock visibly at string and arrow aligned along the bow, release and recover. Only one physical arrow, no energy or detached magical effect. Four new drawings distinct from super/finishing. Columns 5-8 HIT REACTION: four non-graphic flinch/guard/balance/recovery positions; intact character, no wounds.

Solo non-graphic animation acting only, no victim, enemy, blood, injury, corpse, severing, death or graphic violence. Intro/outro/victory/defeat/idle/run/hit are calm ordinary acting and never fire, strike, emit offensive effects or gain new powers. Supports stay zero-damage in ALL sequences including SUPER and FINISHING PRESENTATION. No generalized aura, no body glow, no borrowed power. Exact 48 figures, 8 columns x 6 rows, transparent background.
